name: Gakuen ~Nerawareta Chitai~
source:
Main character belongs to the photography club. One day he receives a news of a cute foreign student girl coming to this school. He starts to burn with desire to make her his own no matter what means it takes. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主角隶属摄影社。一天，他得知一名可爱的外国女学生即将转入学校，便燃起强烈欲望，决心不择手段地将她占为己有。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
